title: Specify -webkit-appearance: fieldset and legend: auto

labels.name: do not merge yet
labels.description: Pull request must not be merged per rationale in comment

body:
Define fieldset's rendering in terms of a new 'webkit-appearance' value, so that web developers can turn off the "magic".

Fixes https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/3912

This is on top of https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/3934

Per discussion in https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/3094 this is likely to change to use a different approach.

Tests:
https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/12677
https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/12940
(Also see commit https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/12691/commits/f8d9bc2b8f1695bec4cc4ad879f15522cb78c1d8 in https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/12691 )
